zone.takeaway: Dayton's SOPEC aggregation renewed at 10.691¢/kWh (100% renewable, AEP Energy supply) from June 2026 through the June 2027 meter read, up from 8.71¢ — a 22.7% increase.
zone.hook: Dayton's city program went from 8.71 to 10.69 cents in June — almost 23% more. Have you compared a fixed commercial contract?
zone.notes: SOPEC aggregation, AEP Energy supply. Prior term 8.71¢/kWh through June 2026. Current term 10.691¢/kWh, 100% renewable, through the June 2027 meter read (EnergyChoiceMatters, 2026-04-09). AES Ohio (formerly Dayton Power & Light) territory. AES Ohio residential Price to Compare is 10.86¢ (June 2026–May 2027).

zone.takeaway: Riverside's SOPEC aggregation moved from 9.333¢ to 10.691¢/kWh in June 2026, running through the June 2027 meter read.
